sentence: This project builds a laser measurement system and calibration strategies to improve the measurement of trace level analytes in liquid samples.
This project tries to find out how the insect cuticle is protected from chitinases while the old cuticle is broken down during molting.
This project holds a gathering where scientists discuss and work together on biomolecular research.
This project studies how single yeast cells evolve into complex cell aggregates in a long term evolution experiment.
This project builds privacy protection methods so organizations can work together to detect cyberattacks without exposing sensitive information.
This project builds a single control system that coordinates scheduling, memory and communication across the different processors in supercomputers.
This project builds a spectrometer that studies molecules on the surface of a single droplet.
This project builds a two-way communication system between humans and plants to predict and change how crops behave.
This project builds a printing method that makes custom hearing devices in one step from a soft, silicone-based resin.
This project studies how thermal radiation from metals changes while they melt and solidify during metal additive manufacturing.
This project builds deep-learning tools that use satellite data to work out how polar ice sheets flow.
This project creates a course sequence that teaches design thinking and robotic manufacturing of precision devices.
This project develops a handheld pen that uses electrical pulses to deliver nucleic acid vaccines through skin without lipid nanoparticles.
This project builds automated ways to save and restart the training of deep learning models on shared computing resources.
This project builds computer methods that map neurons and their connections in 3D images of whole Drosophila brains.
This project develops a way for hundreds of robots to plan paths and move safely through congested environments.
This project works on cybersecurity, including areas such as machine learning, computer forensics, intrusion detection and cryptography.
